single_intervention_shadow.policy: Sort the three first-eligible opportunities by root time and sequence; change only the first supported negative-prediction action, then permanently follow pi_ref

stable.oracle_scope: Evaluation-only minimum of no action and the three queried single-root interventions; future truth is not available to the deployed policy

local_speed_drop.oracle_scope: Evaluation-only minimum of no action and the three queried single-root interventions; future truth is not available to the deployed policy

single_intervention_shadow.interpretation: These costs reconstruct at most one intervention per scenario. Query means and sums do not represent this policy.

promotion.decision: HOLD state readout; do not retune on heldout truth or substitute the line baseline

interpretation.policy_cost_scope: Means and sums of separate single-root paired queries, not repeated-intervention full-day policy costs
interpretation.direction_scope: Prediction accuracy uses supported states only; all valid states count in selector cost and regret, including explicit reference fallback
interpretation.truth_scope: New labels score frozen issue-time predictions only; no heldout label enters fitting
